assumptions: Phase 1 only — interactive TUI explorer, HTML/SVG and Mermaid export are later phases built on the same saved-graph schema.
tests/visualise-stubs.ts exists only because bun cannot load real pi-tui (fs.globSync); the stubs faithfully mirror visibleWidth/truncateToWidth.
The graph JSON under ~/.pi/agent/visualisations/ is the durable model contract — renderers can be added without changing what the agent emits.

nodes.label: Context source
nodes.note: auto-infer branch, repo, last, or full conversation

notes.text: Flags parsed anywhere in args; default mode auto-infers from the conversation branch (user + assistant text parts).
Idle → delivered immediately; mid-run → queued as followUp. Bails with a warning if no topic, no conversation, and no --repo.
The agent owns all the thinking: research, diagram-kind choice, node/edge/note content. The tool owns only validation, rendering, persistence.
Rejects empty nodes, duplicate node/group ids, dangling edge refs, unknown group refs, unresolvable note refs. Errors return as tool text, not exceptions.
Deterministic: BFS-depth node ordering, cycle-safe, every line ≤ 100 cols. Notes numbered with [ref] anchors; assumptions and sources rendered as sections.
Saved as <timestamp>-<slug>.json under ~/.pi/agent/visualisations/; outputDir is injectable so tests use a temp dir.
